note: City of Monmouth campground on Citizens Lake at the edge of town, beside US-67 (some road noise). Playground and fishing. --Claude
summary: City page read live via headless browser. Confirmed 30 full-service sites (W/E/S), hot showers, dump, $45 nightly / $145 weekly / $475 monthly, reservations by phone with the campground manager (Apr 1-Oct 31). Lakeview kept (park road between pads and the open grass shore). Long-stay wording flagged.
flags: LONG-STAY (local; reviewer's call): the city's reservation policy puts nightly guests last - 'Reservation preference for specified camp sites will be given in the following order: Monthly, Weekly, Weekend' and 'Preferably any seasonal reservations for specific sites will be made by April 1st'; a week costs $145 against $45 a night. Overnight stays are accepted ('Reservations will be accepted for: Season, Month, Week, Weekend, Overnight'), so it is not a 'nightly by approval' wording, but it leans seasonal. A leaf-off image shows 2 RVs; no summer occupancy measured. Google 4.3 over 108.

WATERFRONT (lakeview kept, checked hard): the pads are a herringbone block east of the campground's park road; the western pad ends sit ~25-45 m from Citizens Lake across that road and open mowed grass - the road rules out on-water, the open ground supports the view.

SEASON: the page gives the campground manager's phone 'from April 1st to October 31st' (off-season contact City Hall 309-734-2141); that implies the April-October season but is not a stated season - stored derived Apr 1-Oct 31 left as is.
ELECTRIC: the page says 'electricity' without amperage; stored 50 A (from earlier note prose) left unconfirmed.
PHONE 309-221-5131 (campground manager, Apr-Oct) confirmed; off-season 309-734-2141 (City Hall). WEBSITE confirmed.
